OnlineRoom.title: OnlineRoom
OnlineRoom.description: Real-time 1v1 online multiplayer battle room for both Quick Match and Friend Code duels.

roomId.description: Unique room identifier (6-char Friend Code for friend rooms, or qm_XXXXXX for Quick Match).

kind.description: Whether this room is a public Quick Match or a private Friend Code room.

status.description: Lifecycle phase of the 1v1 match; finished is a locked terminal state.

modeId.description: Selected battle mode for the timed 1v1 match.

wasRandomMode.description: True when mode was randomly selected by Quick Match or Random Mode button.

deckSeed.description: Deterministic PRNG seed shared by both players so both receive identical questions.

hostUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the room creator (immutable).

hostName.description: Display name of the host player (no PII).

hostAvatar.description: Country flag code used as the host avatar.

guestUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the joining opponent/friend (empty string while waiting).

guestName.description: Display name of the guest player (empty while waiting).

guestAvatar.description: Country flag code used as the guest avatar (empty while waiting).

hostScore.description: Current cumulative score of the host player.

hostCorrect.description: Number of correct answers submitted by the host.

hostAnswered.description: Total answers submitted by the host.

hostStreak.description: Active correct streak of the host.

hostBestStreak.description: Highest streak achieved by the host in this match.

hostQuestionIndex.description: Current question index reached by the host (0..60).

guestScore.description: Current cumulative score of the guest player.

guestCorrect.description: Number of correct answers submitted by the guest.

guestAnswered.description: Total answers submitted by the guest.

guestStreak.description: Active correct streak of the guest.

guestBestStreak.description: Highest streak achieved by the guest in this match.

guestQuestionIndex.description: Current question index reached by the guest (0..60).

startedAtMs.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when countdown started (0 while in lobby).

endsAtMs.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when the timed battle ends (0 while in lobby).

winnerUid.description: UID of the winner once finished, or empty string for draw/unfinished.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when room was created (immutable).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest state transition.

/onlineRooms/{roomId}.description: Real-time 1v1 multiplayer match rooms (Quick Match and Friend Code lobbies).
